name: epidermal growth factor receptor

function.text: EGFR encodes an epidermal growth factor receptor family tyrosine kinase that activates growth and survival pathways, including RAS–MAPK and PI3K–AKT signaling.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to non-small cell lung carcinoma (autosomal dominant); lung cancer (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations are described across multiple tumor groups, including Lung adenocarcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma; Esophageal adenocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: EGFR encodes an epidermal growth factor receptor family tyrosine kinase that activates growth and survival pathways, including RAS–MAPK and PI3K–AKT signaling.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with non-small cell lung carcinoma (autosomal dominant); lung cancer (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EGFR have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype, and glioblastoma.
